slides.title: Borana's cattle markets have gone quiet
slides.body: Fighting that began in Moyale has spread into parts of Borana, now in its third week, Addis Standard reports.

slides.title: cattle trucks at Haroo Bakkee's Sunday market
slides.body: A resident said about 40 trucks used to come. Now three or fewer arrive.

slides.title: for a young bull that sold for 120,000–150,000
slides.body: A Yabello District resident told Addis Standard prices have collapsed.

slides.title: Buyers from Kenya have stopped coming
slides.body: Traders from Marsabit, Moyale and Sololo have left. Only local butchers buy, at low prices, a Dubuluq resident said.

slides.title: drop in market activity, an economist estimates
slides.body: A Borana University economist warned that selling breeding stock now could leave families in long-term poverty.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Get food aid to herding families.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
